messages:
Harper (Marketing): Heads-up team — planning to publish the release announcement + changelog tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Need final docs permalink, a short bench line, and webinar reg link by EOD.

Diego (Eng): Roger. Recommend a canary freeze at 8:45am PT to avoid publish overlap. I'll note a tiny batching behavior in the migration guide (non-breaking).

Iris (Product): No breaking changes for standard usage. User-visible: routing tweaks for short sessions -> p95 improves. I'll draft the product blurb.

Karan (Docs): Draft changelog preview is up: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v9-preview. Will add migration note once Diego posts the wording.

Maya (Release): We need a permalink by 6pm PT for the site pipeline. If deploy is green, target merging the blog at 9:30am PT for a quick QA pass.

Theo (Events): Webinar slot booked 11:00am PT (30m). Need an Eng co-presenter for ~8 mins. Diego, can you take 11:00-11:08?

Diego (Eng): Yep, 11:00-11:08 works. I'll prepare a 2-slide micro-benchmark and export a PNG to /drive/marketing/assets by 5:00pm PT. Caption: "internal bench — p95 latency — short sessions".

Harper (Marketing): Bench copy check: could we say "up to 26% lower p95 on short-chat workloads"?

Diego (Eng): 26% is a representative median across our testbed. I'd prefer "up to ~26%" for the blog.

Iris (Product): Sounds good. Proposed marketing line: "up to ~26% lower p95 latency on short-chat workloads (internal benchmark)."

Karan (Docs): Changelog snippet draft:
```
## v9.0 — Routing + cache refinements (2026-10-05)
- Adaptive routing for short-session traffic
- Prefix KV cache optimizations to cut redundant compute
- Fix: stable quantization fallback for mixed-precision paths
```

Harper (Marketing): Perfect. Please paste the final permalink here once the docs deploy so I can add it to the blog and social copy.

site-bot: scheduled_deploy: docs-site job 25437 — ETA ~9m

Maya (Release): Monitoring deploy. If green, we'll merge blog at 9:30am PT and publish at 10:00am PT.

Diego (Eng): Uploaded bench PNG to /drive/marketing/assets/v9-bench.png at 16:12 PT.

Karan (Docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978 — includes migration note and preview link.

site-bot: docs-site job 25437 — SUCCESS. Changelog live: https://redwood.inference/docs/changelog/v9.0

Harper (Marketing): Got the permalink. I'll merge the blog at 9:30am PT for quick QA and schedule publish for 10:00am PT. Social posts will follow + assets. :tada:

Theo (Events): Webinar reg link: https://events.redwood.ai/webinar/2026-10-routing-cache — recording + auto-upload confirmed. Speakers: Diego co-presenting.

Diego (Eng): I'll be on standby to answer live questions in the webinar channel. Ping me there.

Maya (Release): Final checklist: docs permalink (done), changelog live (done), blog draft + images queued (Harper), canary freeze 8:45am PT (Diego), webinar confirmed (Theo), PRs merged & pipeline green (Maya). All set.
